mentions.name: Chromatose
mentions.description: A video synthesizer app for iOS for creating and performing unique visuals on the go. It is freemium with access to all features, with a limit of 2 saved patches.
mentions.audience: People creating and performing unique visuals on the go
mentions.source_excerpt:
My new video synthesizer app for iOS.

https://www.chromatose.app

For creating & performing unique visuals on the go.

Freemium w/ access to all features (just a 2 patch save limit).
